newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 511 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 511 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 511 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 88 wheat contracts, 267 corn, 147 soybean, 6 soymeal and 3 oats futures contracts traded, along with 20 wheat put, 2 corn put and 2 soybean put options.
The overnight trend for corn was up 1-1/4 to 1-3/4 cents per bushel, soybeans up 1-1/4 to 3-1/4 cents, wheat up 1/4 to 3 cents, soymeal up $4.20 a ton and oats up 1-3/4 cents a bushel.
